svg.title: A frame in time on the cores: threads against commands
svg.text: One frame on the cores, both forms on one time axis
Sponza's overview, 1,920 x 1,080, lit, one P150A; 11 of the 120 cores; a bar is a thread or a command on that core, blank is standing still
the threads' form: lit_threads, tile pull prefer, 14.584 ms
answers every ask: dp_choose, 3.4 us a choice, 65 % of the pull busy
the stage-wise form: lit, every command on every core, 18.838 ms
Threads: a core asks for its next thread when its last ends (an ask is 0.3 us at the median); 14 to 20 tile threads a core;
the tile pull's end waits only for the last tile thread. Stage-wise: each command (a tick on X280 1's row) ends with its slowest core; the middle pass
(2.028 ms) holds every core. Phase times measured; each core's threads drawn to the measured counts and spans, not one record.
